THE OPPORTUNITY

Mobile Field Capture & Project Dashboards.

A connected tablet app that replaces paper field tickets, feeding live project, equipment, and fuel margin — so cost overruns get caught while the job is still open.

THE PLATFORM

One Operational Intelligence Platform, two connected layers.

A mobile capture layer that replaces clipboards, and an analytics layer that turns captured data into live metrics — layered on top of the accounting and asset systems, not replacing them.

01
INPUTS · MOBILE FIELD CAPTURE

Capture crew activity one time, in real-time.

Connected tablet app: a guided, button-driven workflow with dependent dropdowns, the full earthwork + equipment-delay taxonomy, crew, and enforced fuel — buffering locally through connectivity dropouts.

02
DATA FOUNDATION

Integrate into one data store.

A cloud warehouse joining field data, fuel, and accounting financials. Accounting + GL/fuel-card connectors, asset-tracking and pipeline ingestion, scheduled batch where APIs are constrained.

03
OUTPUTS · DASHBOARDS & ALERTS

Live project performance, role by role.

Operations, CEO, and Finance dashboards with drill-down from fleet → job → crew → day.

COMMERCIAL TERMS · HOW QOFAI GETS PAID

A partnership built on performance.

We invest. We deliver. You retain the value. QofAI bears all up-front build, licensing, and hosting cost; the client only pays from realized EBITDA gains — and keeps the rest.

If margins don't improve above your locked baseline, QofAI earns nothing.
QOFAI INVESTMENT unconfirmed, see gaps
$275,000 · Engineering, deployment, and all implementation risk — fully absorbed before the client pays a dollar. (unconfirmed, see gaps)
CLIENT UP-FRONT
$0 · No capital outlay. No per-seat BI licensing. Tablets (~18, rugged cases) procured by client — not in contract.
COMPENSATION SCHEDULE
YEAR 1 20% · YEAR 2 10% · YEAR 3 5% · YEAR 4+ 0% · Capped at 2.5× initial investment or 3 years, whichever first; ~$19K/yr support after that.
CLIENT RETENTION
Client retains 80–84%, 100% thereafter.
SCENARIOEBITDA GAINQOFAI COMPCLIENT RETAINEDENT. VALUE
CONSERVATIVE +1.6pp · $1,500,000/yr $640,000 $3,600,000 $10,700,000
BASE CASE +2.2pp · $2,050,000/yr $685,000 $4,900,000 $14,000,000
OPTIMISTIC +2.7pp · $2,600,000/yr $685,000 (cap) $6,200,000 $17,300,000
HOW PAYMENT WORKS
Measured monthly. Actual job & fleet EBITDA margin is compared to the client's locked pre-launch baseline; improvement is expressed in margin points.
Converted to EBITDA. The margin-point gain is applied to financial performance at the contribution basis locked at signing for the term.
Share paid that month. QofAI receives the year's share (20% / 10% / 5%) of that figure — paid monthly until the 2.5× cap or the 3-year term.

Enterprise value at exit assumes a 6× EBITDA multiple on the annual uplift, plus a 0.25× reporting-readiness multiple improvement on ~$6.9M adjusted EBITDA. Directional, for decision support.
